QuestInfo.name: The Truth is Out There 10
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #p2050001# and see if he knows more about what #p2050002# told you.
QuestInfo.1: Go back to #m221000000# and ask #p2050001# for more info concerning what #p2050002# told you.
QuestInfo.2: As soon as the words '#bTest Subject#k' leave your lips, #p2050001#'s eyes darken and he grows very serious. He says #o8860000# may have kidnapped people so as to conduct some kind of horrifying experiment. Go ask #p9390367# about this abomination.

yes.0: #bTest subjects#k? And they even asked for alien samples?
yes.1: I don't know what #o8860000# is planning, but this is dangerous to the harmony of nature.
yes.2: That's why #o8860000# kidnapped all of those good people. He must be conducting some kind of experiments on them!
yes.3: This is larger and far more dangerous than I thought. How did you say you got here?
yes.5: Well, tell your contact what you learned here. Maybe it will lead you to the answers you need.
yes.6: Head back to your contact. Maybe you'll get some new information.
